content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make an over the hill cake, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Apply black fondant "road" across the cake (10 minutes)
Step 2. Purchase dark chocolate cake mix and cocoa powder (30 minutes)
Step 3. Assemble the tiered cake layers (20 minutes)
Step 4. Place a plastic "tombstone" topper on the summit (2 minutes)
Step 5. Research "Over the Hill" cake design ideas (1 hour)
Step 6. Mix the chocolate cake batter (15 minutes)
Step 7. Soften several sticks of unsalted butter (45 minutes)
Step 8. Grease and flour multiple cake pans (10 minutes)
Step 9. Allow cake layers to cool completely on wire racks (2 hours)
Step 10. Prepare a batch of dark chocolate ganache (25 minutes)
Step 11. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees (15 minutes)
Step 12. Slice the domes off the cakes to level them (15 minutes)
Step 13. Sift the dry ingredients into a large bowl (10 minutes)
Step 14. Bake the cake layers in the oven (45 minutes)
Step 15. Check for doneness using a toothpick (2 minutes)
Step 16. Prepare a simple syrup for moisture (10 minutes)
Step 17. Sketch the final cake layout on paper (20 minutes)
Step 18. Pour the batter into the prepared pans (5 minutes)
Step 19. Whip the butter until light and fluffy (8 minutes)
Step 20. Gradually add powdered sugar for buttercream (15 minutes)
Step 21. Beat the frosting until smooth (10 minutes)
Step 22. Wash all used mixing bowls and whisks (20 minutes)
Step 23. Apply a thin crumb coat of frosting (25 minutes)
Step 24. Pipe "Rest in Peace" on the side of the cake (10 minutes)
Step 25. Tint a portion of the frosting grey (5 minutes)
Step 26. Line the bottom of the pans with parchment paper (5 minutes)
Step 27. Clean the kitchen countertops (15 minutes)
Step 28. Carve the cake into a rounded hill shape (30 minutes)
Step 29. Organize the decorating tools and piping bags (10 minutes)
Step 30. Remove cakes from the oven to a cooling area (5 minutes)
Step 31. Melt black candy melts for accents (10 minutes)
Step 32. Verify you have enough eggs and oil (5 minutes)
Step 33. Chill the cake to set the crumb coat (1 hour)
Step 34. Measure out the milk for the frosting (2 minutes)
Step 35. Buy decorative graveyard accessories (1 hour)
Step 36. Fill a piping bag with grey frosting (5 minutes)
Step 37. Take the cakes out of their pans (10 minutes)
Step 38. Prepare the cake board with a dab of frosting (5 minutes)
Step 39. Pipe "Happy 50th Birthday" in cursive (15 minutes)
Step 40. Infuse the simple syrup with vanilla (5 minutes)
Step 41. Take the butter out of the refrigerator (5 minutes)
Step 42. Crumble some chocolate cookies to look like "dirt" (10 minutes)
Step 43. Print out a reference photo of a hill (2 minutes)
Step 44. Pipe small blades of "dead" grass using green icing (20 minutes)
Step 45. Clear a space in the refrigerator for the cake (10 minutes)
Step 46. Cut the cake board to the appropriate size (5 minutes)
Step 47. Brush the cake layers with simple syrup (10 minutes)
Step 48. Check the expiration date on the baking powder (2 minutes)
Step 49. Stack the layers with frosting in between (15 minutes)
Step 50. Set the kitchen timer for the baking duration (1 minute)
Step 51. Apply the final thick layer of frosting (30 minutes)
Step 52. Place edible "rock" candies around the base (15 minutes)
Step 53. Buy a box of black fondant (20 minutes)
Step 54. Wipe the edges of the cake board clean (5 minutes)
Step 55. Read the oven thermometer to ensure accuracy (1 minute)
Step 56. Sweep the kitchen floor (10 minutes)
Step 57. Take a photo of the finished masterpiece (2 minutes)
Step 58. Let the pans cool slightly before handling (15 minutes)
Step 59. Pipe decorative borders around the bottom edge (20 minutes)
Step 60. Apply a second layer of grey frosting to the hill (25 minutes)
